page.layout: One printed page, single column of text with a woodcut initial beside the opening paragraph; no margin notes. Top: page number and dedication heading block, then the running text from top to bottom; catchword/signature absent.

main_text.head: NOBILISSIMO IVVENI, D. IOANNI Droiczinski Polono, amico suo, CHRIST. VRSTISIVS S.
main_text.p: ERTIVS decimus nūc agitur annus, Ornatissime Droiczinski, quando numerandi doctrinam, uicibus demandatæ professionis ita poscentibus, in Gymnasio primùm explicare coepi. Etsi uerò tum eius argumenti libellus, breuitate ac facilitate sua uerè gemmeus, communi multarum Scholarum suffragio, manibus nostris tererentur: animaduerti tamen in hoc μαθημάτων genere eam nobis tum docendi, tum discendi methodum nondum mōstratam esse, quam & huius disciplinæ dignitas, & in immensum fusa utilitas postularet. Maximè uerò Euclidea de numeris Elementa diligentiùs reuoluens, deprehen di,

page.notes: The woodcut initial "I" (historiated, showing figures) is joined to "ERTIVS"; the first word reads "ERTIVS" with the initial letter pictured, probably "VERTIVS" or "Vertius" with the initial omitted. The catchword "di," is treated as the last line of text. The Greek word "μαθηματῶν" is set in small italic beside the line and is transcribed approximately. Signature reads "A 2" at the foot.
